title: Beyond the Basics: the GitHub Copilot Harness
summary: Copilot Studio agents now run on the GitHub Copilot harness (continuous think-act-observe loop). Re-architect agents rather than port them; Workflows replace agent flows.
whyItMatters: Existing agents should be re-architected, and Workflows give predictable cost and control for processes with a known path.

keyPoints.heading: Standard vs GHCP harness
keyPoints.text: Standard: plan then execute. GHCP: continuous thought-action-observation-decide loop from the latest state.

keyPoints.heading: Don't port, re-architect
keyPoints.text: Topics, variables, Power Fx, child agents, Adaptive Cards, agent flows give way to skills, memory, hooks, workflows; knowledge, tools, code execution, connected agents carry over.

keyPoints.heading: Agents vs workflows
keyPoints.text: Agents when the path is agile; workflows when start/end are known with AI where judgment is needed. They can call each other.

keyPoints.heading: Instructions
keyPoints.text: Always loaded; GHCP agents follow them closely. Only include what matters every turn; otherwise use a Skill.

keyPoints.heading: Skills
keyPoints.text: SKILL.md + resources loaded on demand. Avoid vague descriptions, mega-skills, fact dumps, unreviewed community skills.

keyPoints.heading: Knowledge and tools
keyPoints.text: Knowledge (SharePoint, OneDrive, files, sites, ServiceNow, Confluence); tools (MCP, connectors, Work IQ). SharePoint: search, rank, fetch full files into sandbox.

keyPoints.heading: Agent sandbox
keyPoints.text: Isolated Linux/Python workspace for code, charts, Office/PDF files; no outbound internet; DLP still applies.

keyPoints.heading: Hooks
keyPoints.text: Power Automate workflow runs at lifecycle events (SessionStart, PreTool, PostTool, PostToolFailure, AgentStop) and can allow/deny next action.

keyPoints.heading: Memory
keyPoints.text: Per user, per agent; users can view/delete; not shared across users.

keyPoints.heading: Connected agents
keyPoints.text: Task agents only; memory is not passed agent to agent.

keyPoints.heading: Workflows
keyPoints.text: Cloud flow -> agent flow -> workflow. Run in Copilot Studio; triggers, AI nodes (classification, inline/published agents, M365 Copilot, document extract), connectors, functions, human input, code execution (planned), flow control. Prompt nodes become inline agents. Predictable cost.

keyPoints.heading: Human-in-the-loop
keyPoints.text: By design (approvals, forms, adaptive cards, email options) or by judgement (agent requests assistance).

keyPoints.heading: Demo
keyPoints.text: Strategic intelligence code app: workflow trigger -> agent plans -> workflow researches -> agent writes report -> human approves.

anthony: We consistently get requests prime for workflows, but workflows seem unavailable in GCC.
Need a timeline to decide whether to wait or build in the legacy harness.
